description: The committed predicate-schema hash — the value a canonical world export stamps as `predicateSchemaHash` (schemas/canonical-world-export.schema.json) and a save file carries in its WorldSnapshot. Regenerated by US-1 when the KINP identity surface (id/3 + the identity rule pack) entered the schema.
algorithm: sha256 over the newline-joined, canonically sorted `name/arity` list of buildPredicateSchemaSnapshot() — see hashPredicateSchema() in src/prolog/predicate-schema.ts. `kind` is deliberately excluded.
regenerate: npx vite-node -e "import('./src/prolog/predicate-schema').then(m => console.log(m.hashPredicateSchema(m.buildPredicateSchemaSnapshot())))" — or read the value the drift test prints on failure, then commit it together with the schema change.
